name: NorthstarAssist: interventions by session
query:
fields @timestamp, identity.arn, output.outputBodyJson.stopReason as stop
| filter identity.arn like /__HARNESS_ROLE__/ and output.outputBodyJson.stopReason = "guardrail_intervened"
| parse identity.arn "*/BedrockAgentCore-*" as role, session
| stats count(*) as interventions, min(@timestamp) as first_seen, max(@timestamp) as last_seen by session
| sort interventions desc
| limit 50

name: NorthstarAssist: prompt-attack blocks by session
query:
fields @timestamp, identity.arn, @message
| filter identity.arn like /__HARNESS_ROLE__/ and @message like /"type":"PROMPT_ATTACK"/
| parse identity.arn "*/BedrockAgentCore-*" as role, session
| stats count(*) as prompt_attack_blocks, min(@timestamp) as first_seen, max(@timestamp) as last_seen by session
| sort prompt_attack_blocks desc
| limit 50

name: NorthstarAssist: timeline for one session
query:
fields @timestamp, requestId, operation, output.outputBodyJson.stopReason as stop, input.inputTokenCount as in_tokens, output.outputTokenCount as out_tokens
| filter identity.arn like /BedrockAgentCore-REPLACE_WITH_SESSION/
| sort @timestamp asc
| limit 200

name: NorthstarAssist: answers without retrieval
query:
fields @timestamp, identity.arn, requestId, output.outputTokenCount as out_tokens
| filter identity.arn like /__HARNESS_ROLE__/ and operation = "ConverseStream" and output.outputBodyJson.stopReason = "end_turn" and @message not like /"toolResult"/
| parse identity.arn "*/BedrockAgentCore-*" as role, session
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 100

name: NorthstarAssist: largest responses
query:
fields @timestamp, identity.arn, requestId, input.inputTokenCount as in_tokens, output.outputTokenCount as out_tokens, output.outputBodyJson.stopReason as stop
| filter identity.arn like /__HARNESS_ROLE__/
| parse identity.arn "*/BedrockAgentCore-*" as role, session
| sort out_tokens desc
| limit 25

name: NorthstarAssist: harness calls with no guardrail assessment
query:
fields @timestamp, identity.arn, requestId, modelId
| filter identity.arn like /__HARNESS_ROLE__/ and @message not like /"appliedGuardrailDetails":/
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 50

name: NorthstarAssist: top retrieved document per model call
query:
fields @timestamp, identity.arn, requestId
| filter identity.arn like /__HARNESS_ROLE__/ and @message like /"toolResult"/
| parse @message /_document_title\\":\\"(?<document>[^\\]+)/
| stats count(*) as calls by document
| sort calls desc
